description: This file contains SCSS mixins related to images, specifically for responsive images (`img-fluid`) and retina images (`img-retina`). It defines reusable style blocks for handling image scaling and high-resolution background images.

methods.name: img-fluid
methods.description: Mixin for making images responsive by setting max-width to 100% and height to auto.

methods.name: img-retina
methods.description: Mixin for setting a background image suitable for retina displays, with support for different resolutions and sizes.
